description.value: Neutral-cue blocks presented ten pictures matched in content to the smoking-related pictures but lacking smoking-related properties, each for 1 second with a 2-second fixation gap, for a total block duration of 30 seconds. description.value: In two scanning runs, participants viewed blocks of smoking-related and neutral visual pictures interspersed with fixation/resting blocks during ASL scanning. Each run contained thirteen 30-second blocks: six cue blocks and seven fixation/resting blocks. Each cue block presented ten corresponding pictures for 1 second each with a 2-second fixation gap. Smoking-related and neutral blocks were counterbalanced across participants. No subjective ratings or other behavioral responses were collected during scanning.

instructions.value: Participants were required to remain in the scanner and view the presented pictures; no explicit task-response instructions or subjective ratings were reported.
